name: Madonna
hook: The Material Girl who reinvented herself from "Like a Virgin" to Evita, Vogue and beyond.

facts.label: Like a Virgin
facts.statement: The 1984 album Like a Virgin spawned four Top 5 hits, including "Material Girl," and its title song was her first Billboard No. 1.

facts.label: Material Girl
facts.statement: The 1985 hit "Material Girl" gave Madonna her nickname; its line is "'cause the boy with the cold hard cash is always Mr. Right."

facts.label: Papa Don't Preach
facts.statement: "Papa Don't Preach" was a 1986 No. 1 in which Madonna asks her father not to sermonize, and Danny Aiello played the father in its video.

facts.label: Evita
facts.statement: Madonna played Eva Perón, the first lady of Argentina, in the 1996 film Evita, and performed a song from the balcony of Buenos Aires' presidential palace.

facts.label: Vogue
facts.statement: The 1990 hit "Vogue" namechecks Greta Garbo and Marilyn Monroe, and it brought the drag-ball dance style vogue to the mainstream.

facts.label: A League of Their Own
facts.statement: Madonna co-starred in the 1992 film A League of Their Own, and her song "This Used to Be My Playground" played over its closing credits.
associations: This Used to Be My Playground
